name: cleanroom_r2e_functional_prototype_residual_v1
purpose: Low-cost train-only functional hierarchy residual for R2E. Preserve the proven RDKit+ coarse retrieval stack and use EC-prefix prototypes only as a bounded Top-2000 reranking signal. No external benchmark label, benchmark identity, or target EC annotation may enter routing or fitting.

motivation_source.paper: FGW-CLIP / Multi-Alignment Contrastive Learning for Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval
motivation_source.borrowed_principle_only: train-time enzyme functional hierarchy is useful auxiliary supervision; this protocol does not reproduce FGW-CLIP or use UniMol/GW losses
motivation_source.fixed_design_choice: EC prefix level 2, prototype centroids, no learned classifier, no external-performance tuning

development.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint clean2023 internal double-cold

ec_metadata.usage: labels are retained only for entity IDs present in the current fold training pairs; test/dev entity EC labels are never retained by the prototype fitter
ec_metadata.valid_prefix: first two EC components must both be decimal integers
ec_metadata.class_set: intersection of classes meeting both train-only support thresholds

expert.base_model: frozen fold-specific RDKit+ dual tower; no base parameter updates
expert.protein_prototype: L2-normalized mean frozen protein embedding for train proteins annotated with each eligible EC-prefix class
expert.reaction_prototype: L2-normalized mean frozen reaction embedding for train reactions annotated with each eligible EC-prefix class
expert.query_class: argmax cosine similarity between query reaction embedding and train-only reaction prototypes
expert.query_confidence: top1 minus top2 reaction-prototype cosine similarity
expert.candidate_functional_score: cosine similarity between candidate protein embedding and the train-only protein prototype for the predicted query class
expert.final_score: coarse cosine score + residual_scale * candidate_functional_score when query_confidence >= confidence_margin; exact coarse score otherwise

selection.fold_stability: primary-slice MRR and MAP must both improve in at least 2 of 3 folds; neither may regress by more than 0.005 absolute in any fold
selection.if_none_pass: reject V1; do not change EC level, support thresholds, scale grid, or confidence grid using these results

external_policy: No Enzyme-405, Orphan-335, ReactZyme native test, temporal outer, Rhea128->141, or other revealed external result may select this expert. External/native-support evaluation is allowed only after internal confirmation and frozen final integration rules.
